intro: Let's guess Ken's free time! You are Ken now. Listen to my question and choose your answer.

items.context: Today is Monday. School is over. It's rainy. Time to go home.
items.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: I ride a bike in my free time.
I study English in my free time.
I play basketball in my free time.
items.zh: Ken 放學從東側門走路回家，坐在書桌前翻英語課本準備小考。

items.context: It's Monday evening. It's rainy outside.
items.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: I watch TV in my free time.
I ride a bike in my free time.
I play basketball in my free time.
items.zh: 晚上下雨，Ken 和媽媽坐在客廳沙發上看電視。

items.context: Today is Tuesday. It's a cool, sunny morning. Time to go to school.
items.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: I play online games in my free time.
I watch TV in my free time.
I go jogging in my free time.
items.zh: 清晨 Ken 穿運動鞋從家門口沿街慢跑約 370 公尺到學校東側門。

items.context: It's Tuesday afternoon. School is over. It's very hot.
items.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: I listen to music in my free time.
I go jogging in my free time.
I play basketball in my free time.
items.zh: Ken 從學校西側走到隔壁圖書館，吹冷氣、戴上新耳機聽音樂。

items.context: It's Tuesday evening. Time to go home.
items.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: I play baseball in my free time.
I play basketball in my free time.
I play the recorder in my free time.
items.zh: 媽媽到圖書館接 Ken 回家，Ken 在房間拿出直笛練習吹奏。

items.context: It's Wednesday evening. It's cloudy and cold.
items.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: I play basketball in my free time.
I play online games in my free time.
I go camping in my free time.
items.zh: 週三晚上 Ken 在家戴耳機，用電腦和 Tom 連線玩遊戲。

items.context: Today is Thursday. It's rainy after school.
items.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: I surf the Internet in my free time.
I ride a bike in my free time.
I go camping in my free time.
items.zh: 下雨天 Ken 在家用電腦上網，搜尋二水的照片做報告。

items.context: Today is Saturday. It's sunny and windy.
items.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: I watch TV in my free time.
I ride a bike in my free time.
I study English in my free time.
items.zh: 週六 Ken 牽出修好的腳踏車，迎著風從家沿街騎到二水國小找朋友。

items.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: I surf the Internet in my free time.
I play the recorder in my free time.
I play basketball in my free time.
items.zh: Ken 和朋友從學校騎車經過 Ken 家，往東南到水心之初大草原，在籃球架下投籃。

items.context: It's Saturday evening. The sky is clear.
items.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: I go camping in my free time.
I play basketball in my free time.
I play baseball in my free time.
items.zh: 傍晚爸媽來到草原，一家人搭帳篷、點營燈，在草原露營看星星。

items.context: Today is Sunday. It's a sunny morning.
items.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: I play online games in my free time.
I play baseball in my free time.
I listen to music in my free time.
items.zh: 露營隔天早上，爸爸在大草原投球，Ken 戴手套、拿新球棒擊球。
